source_locator.short_quote: the trine and the sextile are each called harmonious, because they are constituted between signs of the same kind

normalized_rule: Classify a trine as harmonious when it joins signs the source calls of the same kind.
synthesis_notes: This is a source-specific sign-configuration classification, not a scientific compatibility claim.
review_notes: The Chapter XVI harmonious label is retained, but its same-kind condition cannot be mapped to one Chapter XV sign-gender arrangement without resolving CONFLICT-PTOLEMY-SIGN-KIND-001. No universal sign-gender scheme is selected.
